strategySummary.model: Approximate Black-Scholes LEAPS without short call overlay using Yahoo adjusted close and trailing realized volatility

assumptions.signal: RSI(14) < 35 with tiered VIX entry filters
assumptions.sigma1: mean+1std <= VIX < mean+2std -> buy 1 contract max once per week, exits <12m +120%, 12-15m +60%, 16-18m +30%
assumptions.sigma2First: first RSI<35 and VIX >= mean+2std signal in the last 60 trading days -> buy 1 contract, exits <12m +150%, 12-15m +80%, 16-18m +30%
assumptions.sigma2Repeat: second or later RSI<35 and VIX >= mean+2std signal in the last 20 trading days -> buy 2 contracts, or 1 if cash only covers one, exits <12m +150%, 12-15m +80%, 16-18m +30%
assumptions.sigma2GapAssumption: if a sigma2 day is not the first sigma2 signal in the last 60 trading days and also not the second-or-later sigma2 signal in the last 20 trading days, no sigma2 entry is taken
assumptions.shortCallIvAssumption: not applicable because short call overlay is disabled
assumptions.forcedExit: force exit LEAPS at 180 days to expiry
assumptions.capital: start with $20000 and do not add capital later
assumptions.sizingAssumption: sigma1 requires enough cash for 1 contract; sigma2 repeat buys 2 if possible, otherwise 1 if cash covers one contract; otherwise the signal is skipped
